items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And Richard Wright, by the way, he was -- that boy that wrote --

ctx.x: So now, we're in the early '60s now?

I'm running through '62, '63. I'm running through it and I'm coming around to '67 or '68. Now, '66, I heard rumors that the boss was going to sell the place. So now, you know, I told him if you're going to sell the place you're going to make a profit, you've got to give me some of this profit, I've been helping you make this money. So he went into this (stuff----table) because he was poor when he come in, and I helped him. I made him give me a standing account, if you come in with your party or group, somebody's…
